title: Discord pre-TLS diagnostic pktdebug
summary: Readiness/observability seed for the Discord Linux updater SYN-SENT problem: queues Discord edge TCP 443/5222 through an explicit capturePolicy and uses pktdebug to prove whether nfqws2 sees early-flow packets before tuning bypass tricks.
intendedFor: Stage 7n owner-selected diagnostic before importing more Windows community presets
prove nft counter / NFQUEUE / nfqws2 visibility for Discord updater SYN/early-flow packets
not expected to fix Discord by itself; use it to collapse the hypothesis space
notes: This is a diagnostic strategy, not a bypass promise. Its success criterion is observability: nft counters move and nfqws2 debug shows pktdebug for the Discord edge flow.
Run the runtime with ZAP2_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 when testing this seed so nfqws2 writes the debug log path shown by --runtime-logs.
The capturePolicy is explicit because hostlist/SNI classification is too late for a SYN-SENT updater blocker.
If tcpdump sees Discord SYN while nft counters stay at zero, fix nft scope before tuning lua-desync options.
